quest.title: As the Burning Sun Sears Shadows
quest.description: The Heart of the Sacred Mountain is infested by the Abyss. Its influence must be eliminated.

talks.objective: Enter the huge space beneath the volcano

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Who'd have thought there'd be such a huge space underneath this volcano?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And it's wall-to-wall Abyss in here... Now that Paimon thinks about it, the Abyss covering the entrance probably crawled up from down here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: O Chosen of Dragons, the power of blazing fire now rests within you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go forth and vanquish the great enemy cloaked in shadow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. What's this fuzzy warm strength Paimon feels all over...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, that's a "later" question. Let's use it to send the Abyss packing, right here and now!

talks.objective: Clear out the Abyss and release the Astral Assemblage(s)
